To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Internet of Things is the Internet of Things, and it is a good thing.
the Internet of Vehicles (IoV) will enable autonomous, intelligent vehicles to communicate with each other and the infrastructure to improve safety and efficiency of transportation.

the Internet of Vehicles, a new paradigm in transportation, will enable autonomous vehicles, which will be connected to the Vehicular cloud, a distributed cloud infrastructure, which will provide services for autonomous driving.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to enable the Internet of Vehicles, and how it can be leveraged for a variety of applications, such as traffic control, pollution control, and smart cities.

the following topics: 1) the design of intelligent, Internet-connected vehicles, 2) the design and deployment of the Vehicular Network (VehNet) that interconnects the vehicles, 3) the design of the VehCloud that provides all the services required to the VehNet.
the following: (1) how to make cars intelligent, (2) how to make the cars autonomous, and (3) how to make vehicles part of a larger Internet-connected fabric.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Internet of Vehicles, as a concept, is a reality, and that the Vehicular cloud is a promising technology for the realization of the Internet of Vehicles.
, the Internet of vehicles will be a distributed fabric, capable to make its decisions about driving customers from one place to another.
the Internet of Vehicles has the potential of becoming the most important instantiation of the Internet of Everything.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are working on the Internet of Vehicles.
we are trying to make the car smarter and more autonomous.
we are moving from the intelligent vehicle grid to the internet of vehicles and vehicular clouds.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Internet of Vehicles requires a paradigm shift, as it is not a mere extension of the Internet of Today, but rather a new instantiation of it.

the Internet of Vehicles can be seen as the Internet of Things for the transport industry, and that it can benefit from the lessons learned in the development of other instantiations of Internet of Things.

the Internet of Vehicles requires a paradigm shift from the current centralized, human-centric approach to the decentralized, machine-centric approach, and that the Vehicular cloud will play a key role in the evolution of the Internet of Vehicles.
